conviction_note: My findings sum to +3.5 because the cause of this fall was POSITIVE news - a Phase 2 that met its primary and key secondary endpoints and beat its active omalizumab comparator on durability - so the 23.7% close-to-close fall is the unwind of a +50% 20-day run-up and an intraday distribution into the pop, not a re-rating of the asset; I cut that to +1.5 because the two strongest free signals in the baseline both point the other way (22.5x volume, whose measured next-session base rate is -2.44%, and a 14-day ATR of 15.4%, which the brief names as the best free ranker of continuation) and because short interest is only ~318k shares at ~2 days to cover, so there is no squeeze mechanism to force the bounce.
bar: Positive topline Phase 2 results for CUE-221 in chronic spontaneous urticaria, released 2026-09-20 06:00 ET with a 2026-09-21 08:00 ET conference call: HSS7=0 at week 12 of 54%/53%/43% at 4/2/1 mg/kg vs 11% placebo and 41% omalizumab, UAS7=0 46% at 4 mg/kg vs 11% placebo and 29% omalizumab, and 60% vs 24% complete hives resolution maintained at week 28 - with no PK or IgE data released and the study run in China by a related party of the licensor. https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/20/3365072/0/en/cue-biopharma-announces-positive-topline-results-from-cue-221-phase-2-study-in-chronic-spontaneous-urticaria.html

cause.label: clinical_or_binary_readout
cause.what_happened: Cue Biopharma released positive CUE-221 Phase 2 CSU topline on Sunday 2026-09-20 at 06:00 ET and held its call at 08:00 ET on Monday 2026-09-21; the stock gapped UP 3.91%, traded up as much as ~40% intraday, and then fell 26.6% from the open to close -23.70% on 22.5x normal volume, i.e. the fall was the removal of an event premium built by a +50.5% 20-day run-up and distribution into the pop rather than a negative information surprise.

evidence.claim: Press release dated 2026-09-20 06:00 ET announcing positive topline Phase 2 results for CUE-221 in CSU, with a conference call scheduled for 2026-09-21 at 8:00 a.m. EDT; primary endpoint HSS7=0 at week 12 was 54% (4 mg/kg, p<0.005), 53% (2 mg/kg, p<0.005) and 43% (1 mg/kg, p<0.05) vs 11% placebo and 41% omalizumab.

Form 8-K filed 2026-09-21 (accession 0001193125-26-396094) carrying items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 with the press release as Exhibit 99.1 and a corporate presentation as Exhibit 99.2; the 8-K contains no financing, offering, share-count or runway disclosure of any kind.

The stock 'surged more than 40% on September 21, 2026 after positive Phase 2 topline results ... then dropped over 27% intraday as traders locked in gains and weighed funding risks' - the reversal, not the data, is what wire copy identifies as the move.
B. Riley attributed the 24% decline to $28.27 to the absence of pharmacokinetic and IgE data rather than to the efficacy result, and maintained Buy with an $83 target.

positioning_check: FINRA short interest 318,420 shares at the 2026-08-31 settlement, 4.65-4.9% of float and 1.76-2.10 days to cover (https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/stocks/cue/short-interest, https://fintel.io/ss/us/cue, both read 2026-09-22); Equibles models 337,484 shares for the 2026-09-15 settlement, i.e. essentially unchanged (https://equibles.com/stocks/cue/short-interest). In absolute terms that is roughly $9m of short at the drop-day close against a session that traded ~$99.8m, so there is NO squeeze fuel here and a positive number cannot lean on one. Float is small: a 1-for-30 reverse split on 2026-04-23 took shares outstanding from ~97.7m to ~3.3m and the July 2026 PIPE added 1,418,071 shares plus 87,500 pre-funded warrants, so ~3.5m shares traded on the drop day is on the order of the entire share count turning over once. The option chain gives no directional read at all: the baseline reports status 'unusable_chain', no two-sided ATM legs, total open interest 425 contracts and a null 25-delta skew, so there is no put skew either to agree with or to argue against.

findings.finding: The cause of this fall is a readout the company and the sell side both call positive: CUE-221 met its primary endpoint with a clean dose response (54%/53%/43% HSS7=0 vs 11% placebo), met the key secondary (UAS7=0 46% at 4 mg/kg vs 11%), beat the active omalizumab comparator numerically at week 12 (54% vs 41%) and by 36 points on durability at week 28 (60% vs 24%, p<0.05), with no treatment-related serious adverse events and no anaphylaxis - so nothing disclosed on 09-20/09-21 lowers the asset's expected cash flows, and the 23.7% fall is the unwind of an event premium rather than a markdown.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The baseline's eight comparable falls of -16.6% or worse over three years are a coin flip on the next close: up-rate 50.0%, median -0.42%, mean -1.59%, with a +4.38% next close after the largest of them (-30.54% on 2026-04-28) and +9.03% after -18.77% on 2026-01-15. This name does not systematically follow through after a big down day.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has already moved on this, and it moved the WRONG way relative to the content: it gapped UP 3.91% and traded up ~40% before collapsing. If the market had read the data as bad, the stock would have opened down and the fall would have been overnight; the baseline's gap_share of -0.165 says the opposite. What the intraday 26.6% decline reflects is supply from holders sitting on a +50.5% 20-day gain and on B. Riley's 09-18 initiation, not a repricing of the programme - and that supply, unlike a guidance cut, does not renew itself the next morning.
findings.independence: B. Riley, which initiated at Buy/$83 on 2026-09-18, published on the drop day that it would accumulate into the decline and named the missing PK/IgE data - not the efficacy - as the reason for the weakness: https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9090443/b-rileys-buy-rating-on-cue-biopharma-cue-highlights-markets-high-pricetosales-expectations

findings.finding: The 'funding risk' the tape priced during the reversal did not arrive: EDGAR shows NO filing by Cue Biopharma after the 2026-09-21 8-K as of 2026-09-22 pre-market - no S-1, no S-3, no 424B, no item 3.02 - and the 10-Q filed 2026-08-14 states that $17.4m of cash at 2026-06-30 plus the net proceeds of the July 2026 $50m private placement funds projected operating needs for at least twelve months, so the single largest one-session tail risk for a post-pop microcap biotech is off the table for this window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This issuer has repeatedly raised into strength - a ~$20m offering in April 2025, a $10m offering in December 2025 at $0.28 pre-split, and the $50m PIPE at $33.21 in July 2026 - so an overnight raise into a 40% pop was the specific fear, and its absence is informative rather than neutral.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has already moved on the POSSIBILITY of a raise - that is what 'weighed funding risks' in the 09-21 wire copy means - and an option chain with 425 contracts of open interest and no two-sided ATM quotes gives holders no way to hedge it, so the discount was taken in the stock. If the market had known the company would not file, the reversal from +40% to -24% would have been visibly smaller. The part the move did not reflect is that the 10-Q's own twelve-month runway language makes a raise at a 24% discount to Friday actively irrational for management.
findings.independence: The 10-Q for the period ended 2026-06-30, filed 2026-08-14, carries the runway statement and the $17.4m cash figure independently of the EDGAR index: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001645460/000119312526352128/cue-20260630.htm

findings.finding: B. Riley's Mayank Mamtani, who initiated coverage at Buy with an $83 target on Friday 2026-09-18, published on the drop day itself that the firm plans to ACCUMULATE shares into the 24% decline, calling the trial outcomes better than expected and blaming the weakness on the undisclosed PK and IgE data - a named, dated buyer standing under the stock going into the next session.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Sell-side support is weak evidence in general, but this name has only just acquired coverage: the 09-18 initiation is listed among Benzinga's top five initiations for that Friday, so the marginal institutional buyer here is new and has publicly committed rather than being a legacy holder trimming.
findings.why_not_priced: The note landed into the same tape that was liquidating, so it was absorbed by forced supply rather than setting the price; what the close does not reflect is that the supply was one day of profit-taking while the buy recommendation persists into 09-22. If it had been priced, the close would not sit 15% BELOW the $33.21 at which institutions bought the July PIPE, on a day the company reported a Phase 2 success.
findings.independence: The 2026-09-18 initiation is carried separately by Benzinga: https://www.benzinga.com/analyst-stock-ratings/downgrades/26/09/61864885/this-cue-biopharma-analyst-begins-coverage-on-a-bullish-note-here-are-top-5-initiations-for-friday

findings.finding: The data cannot be used to register CUE-221 in Cue's own territory and the arms that generate the headline comparisons are tiny: the study was run in CHINA by Genesis Life Sciences, a related company of Ascendant Health from which Cue licensed the ex-China rights in April 2026, and the omalizumab and placebo arms are N=17 and N=18 against N=35/36/37 on drug - so the 54%-vs-41% and 60%-vs-24% cross-arm claims rest on seventeen comparator patients, and Cue must still fund and run its own Phase 2b/3 registration-enabling CSU study plus a Phase 2 in food allergy on roughly $63m of pro-forma cash.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Cue's own recent large falls that were about the programme rather than the tape followed through hard: -21.18% on 2026-04-21 was followed by -13.43%, and -19.18% on 2026-08-17 by -7.02%. Two of the baseline's eight comparables did worse than -11% the next session.
findings.why_not_priced: Most of this IS priced - it is the reason the stock gave back the pop. The part that is not yet in Monday's close is the sell-side and buy-side write-ups that land overnight and on 09-22 morning working through the arm sizes and the China-only provenance, which is the standard pattern after a topline that reads well in the headline and thinner in the table. If it were fully priced, the stock would not have traded up 40% before anyone read the N's.
findings.independence: The 10-Q filed 2026-08-14 independently establishes the cash base the registrational programme has to be funded from ($17.4m at 2026-06-30 plus the July PIPE, described as at least twelve months of runway, with 'substantial additional capital' still required): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001645460/000119312526352128/cue-20260630.htm

findings.finding: There is a registered, motivated supply block that one session did not clear: the July 2026 private placement sold 1,418,071 shares at $33.21 plus 87,500 pre-funded warrants into a company that had only ~3.3m shares outstanding after the 1-for-30 reverse split of 2026-04-23, and an EDGAR form EFFECT dated 2026-08-20 shows a registration statement going effective a month later - so on the order of 30% of the share count is freely saleable stock in hands with a known basis, and Monday's ~3.5m shares of volume is the first day those hands have had a bid worth hitting since the run-up.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The baseline's own worst comparable, -21.18% on 2026-04-21 followed by -24.63% at the next open and -13.43% at the next close, sits immediately before the reverse split and the recapitalisation, i.e. this register has followed through when it was the supply and not the news doing the work.
findings.why_not_priced: One session of 22.5x volume plainly absorbed a large part of it, which is why this is sized at -1.0 and not larger, and the $28.27 close is 15% BELOW the $33.21 PIPE price, so the remaining holders are underwater and their urgency to sell is much reduced. What the close does not reflect is that a block this size relative to the float usually takes more than one session to distribute; if it had been cleared, the day would not have needed roughly a full turn of the share count to do it.

outside_window.finding: The complete 36-week data set including the pharmacokinetic and IgE analyses - the specific gap B. Riley names as the reason for the selloff - will be presented at an unnamed 'upcoming scientific meeting', with no date given, so it cannot resolve inside this window but is the obvious re-rating catalyst when it lands.

A Phase 2b/3 registration-enabling CSU study plus a Phase 2 in food allergy cannot be funded from ~$63m of pro-forma cash, and this issuer has raised four times since April 2025, so a follow-on equity financing is close to certain on a multi-month view - but nothing was filed as of 2026-09-22 pre-market, so it is not a risk to this session.

Any short-seller publication on CUE dated 2026-09-21 or 2026-09-22

Any trading halt, Nasdaq notice or LULD reason code for 2026-09-21
Any Form 4 insider purchase or sale dated into the fall - the last Form 4s are 2026-08-17 and the last Form 4/As 2026-08-28

A usable option chain: the baseline reports 'unusable_chain' with 425 contracts of total open interest and no two-sided ATM quotes, so there is no implied move and no 25-delta skew to read a market view from

A clean current float figure - vendor float (~6.5m implied by 318,420 shares being 4.9%) is larger than the post-split plus PIPE share count I can reconstruct (~4.8m), so I have treated the float as 'small and uncertain' rather than quoting it
baseline_tension: My findings cut squarely AGAINST the two strongest free signals in the baseline - the 22.51x volume spike, whose measured next-session base rate in my brief is -2.44% with only a 38.8% rise rate, and the 15.4% 14-day ATR, which the brief names as the best free ranker there is and which says high-volatility names keep falling - while the name's OWN history of eight comparable falls is genuinely neutral (50% up rate, median -0.42%) and the option chain is unusable, so there is no skew either way; that is why the emitted +1.5 is two full points below the +3.5 my findings sum to.
